base.text:
Death: Resummon this at Stage 1.
Quest: Stage 1, Upload Resume. Activate this to send a card from your hand in as your resume. Reward: Hear back in 2 to 6 turns.
Quest: Stage 2, The Interview. One of three, drawn at random: play a card that costs the same as your resume; play 3 cards of different costs in one turn; or take or deal 12 or more damage in one hit. Reward: Add your resume to your hand and Buff it {buffs|time|times}. It costs (0).
Quest: Stage 3, The Offer. Activate this to accept the offer, or to send in another application, back to Stage 1, with every reward tripled. Reward: From your next turn on, add a Paycheck to your hand at the start of each of your turns.
